## RAG API Endpoints (Vector Search - 978+ produktów zaindeksowanych)

Endpoint: https://pumo-rag.stolarnia-ams.workers.dev/api/search
Method: POST
Body: {"query": "search term", "limit": 10}
Response: {"results": [{"name": "...", "category": "...", "price": "...", "url": "...", "score": 0.XX}]}
Description: Semantic search po ~13,388 produktach Meble Pumo (768d embeddings)
Authentication: None (public endpoint)
Rate-Limit: 100 req/min

Endpoint: https://pumo-rag.stolarnia-ams.workers.dev/api/chat
Method: POST
Body: {"query": "user question"}
Response: {"answer": "...", "sources": [...], "confidence": 0.XX}
Description: RAG chatbot z kontekstem produktów
Model: OpenRouter (fallback: Cloudflare Workers AI)

## Rate Limiting
